description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing notifications in a React application. It provides load and markRead actions, and manages notification items, unread count, loading state, and error handling.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches notification data and updates the store; handles loading state and errors.

methods.name: markRead
methods.description: Marks a notification as read by ID and updates the store; handles errors during the process.
